definition: a container, usually with a lid
description: The camera looks straight down into a big grey wheelie bin standing on a path in front of green bushes. A raccoon is sitting at the bottom of the bin next to a crumpled green rubbish bag. It looks up at the camera, then stands up on its back legs and stretches both front paws up the smooth inside wall, trying to get out. It slips back down, turns around and curls up, then sits up again and stares at the camera.

en.question: What is the raccoon trying to do?

de.answer: Er versucht, aus der Mülltonne zu entkommen.
de.question: Was versucht der Waschbär zu tun?

es.answer: Está intentando escapar del cubo de basura.
es.question: ¿Qué está intentando hacer el mapache?

fr.answer: Il essaie de s'échapper de la poubelle.
